name: 01-dashboard
vo: ColdChain Rescue. A cold chain monitoring platform for pharmaceutical and food logistics across the Delhi North Corridor.

name: 02-live-map
vo: Every truck on the map is moving, with its route, its current temperature, speed and load. Fourteen units, one live fleet view.

name: 03-simulation
vo: On simulation, you build the fleet yourself. Add a truck, choose the product and the destination warehouse. Nothing is assigned automatically.

name: 04-approvals
vo: When the agent finds a critical fault, it does not act alone. It proposes the best cold store, scored on time, traffic, capacity and cost, and waits for you to approve.

name: 05-incident
vo: Thirteen incident types are detected from real telemetry. Four more are declared as gaps, because the sensors to detect them honestly do not exist.

name: 06-reports
vo: Every incident ends in a report: the truck, the problem, what the agent did, and what it learned when it could not resolve the fault.

name: 07-settings
vo: Light and dark themes, operator settings, and the system status panel.
